items.t: Said the expulsion of a Senator was a necessary action.
items.q: While the expulsion of a Senator for the first time in history was not something any of us wished to see, it was a necessary action. The integrity of the Senate is of paramount importance.

record.office: Lieutenant Governor of Tennessee and Speaker of the Senate
record.t: Was elected 87th Speaker of the Senate and Lieutenant Governor of Tennessee on January 10, 2017.
record.q: On Tuesday, January 10th, 2017, the Honorable Randy McNally was elected to be the 87th Speaker of the Senate and Lieutenant Governor of the Great State of Tennessee.

record.t: Served as chairman of the Senate Finance, Ways and Means Committee for a decade.
record.q: As chairman of the Senate's Finance, Ways and Means Committee for a decade, McNally

record.t: Served as vice-chair of the Senate Rules Committee.
record.q: Chair, Senate Finance, Ways and Means Committee Vice-Chair, Senate Rules Committee Member, Senate General Welfare Committee

record.t: Served as a Senate member from the 95th through the 105th General Assemblies.
